name: minimap_window
_comment: Wave 10 item 7, take 2: how long after the `h` minimap has faded does a click on its area still work? minimap_fade.json found yes at 0.6 / 1.7 / 4.4 s and no at 11.5 / 22 s after the last visible pixel. Here: h, then clicks about 6, 8, 9.5 and 7 s after each hide (an answered click re-shows the map, which restarts the clock; the recording gives the real gaps). Pilot w2_map at Map Hub; positions as in minimap_fade.json.
